quest.title: Tea Party Re-Invitation: Tartaglia
quest.description: Go to the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with the guests...

talks.objective: Head to a high vantage point in the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau to start the tea party

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Not bad, these tea parties, all in all. If I'd known they were this much fun, I would've attended one sooner.

choices.text: (Let's sit like this for a little while longer.)
I think it's time I started clearing up.
